'''Mos Shuuta''' was a small city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and the location of the [[Teemo's palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]]. Mos Shuuta was situated on the top of a tall, rocky bluff, with nothing but endless desert in every direction around it. The [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] was well established in Mos Shuuta.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The picture used to represent Mos Shuuta in [[The Long Arm of the Hutt]] was first released in the ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' expansion of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], where it was used to represent [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].
